services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: There is nothing so romantic as a moonlit beach, except for a Fireworks Cruise on the waters off Destin's Shores. But, our little paradise offers more than white sandy beaches and emerald water. We welcome honeymooners, newlyweds, and couples looking to bring their dreams into reality. Bring along your special someone for a quiet and beautiful sailing cruise under the fireworks, an experience they will never forget. Then, double the fun by bringing some friends and pulling off the best double date ever! services.name: Swim & Snorkel
services.desc: Smile N Wave Snorkeling Tours offer a terrific way to experience the amazing marine life and beautiful waters of Destin, Florida, while enjoying the sunshine. While snorkeling, some things you may find are Sand Dollars, tons of neat shells, and even starfish. Then, of course, the chance to see our fantastic scenery, up close and personal. Snorkeling near the Destin Pass Jetties offers even more possibility of spotting our incredible marine life. The jetties have a reef-like structure where our aquatic life loves to gather. blurb: Guests sail aboard the trimaran Nice Tri for day charters including swimming, snorkeling, dolphin watching, sunset sails, and visits to Crab Island. Snorkeling tours include shallow water adventures for families and deeper Gulf snorkeling for older guests. Ash-spreading memorial services are also offered on the sailboat.
